full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiffs was that the land belonged to Jhalu Chamar, who died living behind four sons named Sham, Durdeshi, Ramdash and Puruski. They transferred the suit land to Jadab Chandra, Radhika and Mohan Lai on 28.07.1933. Thereafter, the successive heirs of Jadab, Radhika and Mohan transferred-the suit land to the plaintiffs on 17.05.1979. The plaintiffs have been possessing the suit land through Tharatia by constructing three shops. But during the S.A. operation, the suit land was wrongly recorded in the name of Brojo Gopal Lal. Against that record, Radhesham and others filed Miscellaneous Case No.211(X111)/78-79 under section 143 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 and got their names recorded in a separate khatian being Mutation Khatian No.518/1.
